scope: Corollary 1.3 (Infinite minimal tensor powers) of the manuscript “The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion” (preprints/The-Kirchberg-Rordam-character-criterion-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 299 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a0e2d22982358ba1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let D be a nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra without characters, and write B = D⊗min∞ := lim − → n≥1 ( D⊗minn , x |−→ x ⊗ 1D ) . Then B ∼ = B ⊗min Z, and B contains a unital copy of Z.
